Inspected the exact text described by §4.3.1.1 Constant Declaration, printed pp. 4-4 and 4-5 (PDF pp. 64–65). See also §2.6 Package Bodies, printed p. 2-10 (PDF p. 40). IEEE 1076-1987 limits a deferred constant declaration to a package declaration and requires the corresponding full declaration defining its value in the package body. The declaration is a deferred constant declaration under §4.3.1.1. This is the rule for the exact 1987 edition and its deferred-constant construct. Other declaration forms and later editions have separate rules. The opening grammar clause distinguishes declarations with an initializer. The adjacent treatment of formal parameters and generics is under a separate grammar section. The package-body clause independently locates completion in the same standard.
